name: Pal Engine - Desktop Companion
detailed_description:
🧿 Pal Engine — Your Interactive 3D Desktop Companion

Pal Engine brings a fully animated 3D character to your desktop — floating, interactive, customizable, and optionally AI-powered.
Use built-in avatars or upload your own VRM model (anime-style, realistic, or anything in between). Define their personality, control their behavior, and make them uniquely yours.

🤝 Community-Driven Development

Built with the community, for the community.
Share feedback, suggest features, contribute VRM models, animations, and ideas — help shape the future of Pal Engine together.

🔑 Key Features

Load and personalize VRM characters
Import your own avatar or use one of the built-in Alenia models. Customize name, appearance, traits, and personality.

Drag, resize, and rotate freely across screens
Move your character with the right mouse button, rotate using scroll, and place them on any monitor. Scale them via the tray menu.

Optional AI chat
Each character responds according to its own memory, tone, and chat style.

Mouse passthrough toggle
Prevent the character from blocking your clicks when working or gaming. Easily toggle passthrough from the tray menu.

Independent UI windows
Chat and Settings are fully modular. Drag them anywhere, resize, or close them.

Idle animations and expressive reactions (Work in Progress)
Characters react when idle or during chat sessions, with early-stage animations and planned mood systems coming soon.

🛠️ What’s Coming Next

  • Facial expressions (smile, frown, react with emotion)

  • Snap character to screen borders (sit when docked at bottom, lean when touching sides)

  • Vroid SDK integration for effortless custom model import

  • Desktop assistant utilities like notes, timers, and alarms — built based on your feedback

Your desktop, but with personality!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U 1.6GHz / AMD Ryzen 3 3300U
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 730 / Radeon VEGA 8
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: A GPU or a CPU with integrated GPU is required for operation. SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit / Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 2.6GHz / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon RX550 / Intel Iris Xe Graphics / Radeon VEGA 11
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: A GPU or a CPU with integrated GPU is required for operation. SSD Recommended
